ysmragdoll.name: YSM Ragdoll
screen.ysmragdoll.title: YSM Ragdoll Settings
screen.ysmragdoll.testing.strength_hint: Default 70. 0: no traction. 1–99: limited pulling force; lower values are softer and may be too weak to lift the ragdoll. 100: rigid tracking with a straight beam, still blocked by terrain. Soft beams curve with actual ragdoll lag and gradually straighten as it catches up. Apply or Done saves this value.
screen.ysmragdoll.testing.gravity_hint: Enable this mode, hold a stick in your main hand, then hold right-click (Use) on a ragdoll to pull it. Release to let go. Starting, stopping and turning cause gentle inertial sway; releasing while moving carries the ragdoll forward. Scroll up to push away, down to pull closer (1.5–12 blocks), without changing hotbar slots. Changing items or opening a screen ends traction. Toggling saves immediately; Cancel does not undo it.
screen.ysmragdoll.management.hint: Shows this client's ragdolls using applied settings. Removed automatically below Y=-64.
screen.ysmragdoll.spawn.below_void: Below Y=-64: ragdolls are not kept in the void.
screen.ysmragdoll.advanced.create_hint: Create a test ragdoll from your current model using saved settings. At the limit, the oldest ragdoll is replaced.
screen.ysmragdoll.spawn.static_created: Created a static model only; no physics skeleton. Total: %s; physics ragdolls: %s.
screen.ysmragdoll.spawn.no_player: Enter a world as a living, non-spectator player first.
screen.ysmragdoll.spawn.disabled: The ragdoll limit is 0. Change it and apply before creating.
screen.ysmragdoll.spawn.capture_failed: Creation failed. Check that YSM 2.6.5 and your model are loaded; see the log for details.
